title: Cassetu's Pharoah Pack
description: Desert. Pharoah. Cassetu. All of them together to make this pvp texture pack.
body:
Updating Every Week Since 9/8/25!

A basic texture pack. Changes the sword textures to khopesh. Adds better Diamond Axe and Iron Axe. Wind charges are now dust charges. Ender pearls a scarabs. Adds a desert themed mace and breeze rod. Golden Apples are grapes.

Has low fire & no pumpkin overlay
